44144-protection-and-communism.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. owever, seed thus sown cannot remain altogether without fruit, and the rapidity with which correct principles spread through a great community, under apparently most unfavourable circumstances, is such as frequently to astonish even those most convinced of the vast power of truth.

45132-studies-of-travel-greece.title: Studies of Travel
45132-studies-of-travel-greece.creator: Unknown
45132-studies-of-travel-greece.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. he still keeps along the channel which divides free Corfu from enslaved Epeiros; night cuts him off from the sight of the mouth of the Ambrakian Gulf, and of the point where modern diplomacy has decreed that Greek nationality shall, as far as diplomacy can affect such matters, come to an end. The next morning’s dawn finds him off the mouth of the outer Corinthian Gulf.

arxiv-1908-04682.title: CMB-GAN: Fast Simulations of Cosmic Microwave background Anisotropy maps using Deep Learning
arxiv-1908-04682.creator: Amit Mishra, Pranath Reddy, Rahul Nigam
arxiv-1908-04682.description: Abstract Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) has been a cornerstone in many cosmology experiments and studies since it was discovered back in 1964. Traditional computational models like CAMB that are used for generating CMB temperature anisotropy maps are extremely resource intensive and act as a bottleneck in cosmology experiments that require a large amount of CMB data for analysis.

arxiv-2008-06983.title: A Non-Abelian Generalization of the Alexander Polynomial from Quantum 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3}
arxiv-2008-06983.creator: Matthew Harper
arxiv-2008-06983.description: Abstract . Murakami and Ohtsuki have shown that the Alexander polynomial is an R R -matrix invariant associated with representations V ⁡ ( t ) V(t) of unrolled restricted quantum 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 2 \mathfrak{sl}_{2} at a fourth root of unity. In this context, the highest weight t ∈ ℂ × t\in\mathbb{C}^{\times} of the representation determines the polynomial variable.

arxiv-2206-14342.title: Intrinsic Anomaly Detection for Multi-Variate Time Series
arxiv-2206-14342.creator: Stephan Rabanser, Tim Januschowski, Kashif Rasul, Oliver Borchert, Richard Kurle, Jan Gasthaus, Michael Bohlke-Schneider, Nicolas Papernot, Valentin Flunkert
arxiv-2206-14342.description: Abstract We introduce a novel, practically relevant variation of the anomaly detection problem in multi-variate time series: intrinsic anomaly detection . It appears in diverse practical scenarios ranging from DevOps to IoT, where we want to recognize failures of a system that operates under the influence of a surrounding environment.

arxiv-2207-00672.title: The Importance of the Instantaneous Phase for classification using Convolutional Neural Networks
arxiv-2207-00672.creator: Luis Sanchez Tapia, Marios S. Pattichis, Sylvia Celedon-Pattichis, Carlos Lopez Leiva
arxiv-2207-00672.description: Abstract Large scale training of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) is extremely demanding in terms of computational resources. Also, for specific applications, the standard use of transfer learning also tends to require far more resources than what may be needed. This work examines the impact of using AM-FM representations as input images for CNN classification applications.

arxiv-2208-06422.title: E 6 E_{6} Models in Light of Precision M W M_{W} Measurements
arxiv-2208-06422.creator: Vernon Barger, Cash Hauptmann, Peisi Huang, Wai-Yee Keung
arxiv-2208-06422.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Vernon Barger, Cash Hauptmann, Peisi Huang, Wai-Yee Keung. We propose a solution to the recent W W mass measurement by embedding the Standard Model within E 6 E_{6} models. The presence of a new U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) group shifts the W W boson mass at the tree level and introduces a new gauge boson Z ′ Z^{\prime} which has been searched for at collider experiments.

arxiv-2303-13268.title: Modulation of cosmic ray anti-protons in the heliosphere: simulations for a solar cycle
arxiv-2303-13268.creator: O.P.M. Aslam, M.S. Potgieter, Xi Luo (罗熙), M.D. Ngobeni
arxiv-2303-13268.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by O.P.M. Aslam, M.S. Potgieter, Xi Luo (罗熙), M.D. Ngobeni. The precision measurements of galactic cosmic ray protons from PAMELA and AMS are reproduced using a well-established 3D numerical model for the period July 2006 - November 2019.

arxiv-2307-08651.title: Generalized Families of Fractional Stochastic Dominance
arxiv-2307-08651.creator: Ehsan Azmoodeh and Ozan Hür
arxiv-2307-08651.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ehsan Azmoodeh and Ozan Hür. Introduced by Müller et al. in their seminal paper [ 16 ] , fractional stochastic dominance (SD) offers a nuanced approach to ordering distributions. In this paper, we propose a fundamentally new framework by replacing the fixed parameter γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \gamma\in[0,1] in fractional SD with a function 𝛄 : ℝ → [ 0 , 1 ] \boldsymbol{\upgamma}:\mathbb{R}\to[0,1] . This yields two novel families, multi-fractional stochastic dominance (MFSD) and functional fractional stochastic dominance (FFSD).

arxiv-2309-07551.title: Achieving 45% efficiency of CIGS/CdS Solar Cell by adding GaAs using optimization techniques
arxiv-2309-07551.creator: Satyam Bhatti, Habib Ullah Manzoor, Ahmed Zoha, and Rami Ghannam
arxiv-2309-07551.description: Abstract This paper proposes an efficient three-layered p-GaAs/p-CIGS/n-CdS (PPN), a unique solar cell architecture. Copper indium gallium selenide (CIGS)-based solar cells exhibit substantial performance than the ones utilizing cadmium sulfide (CdS). On the contrary, CIGS-based devices are more efficient, considering their device performance, environmentally benign nature, and reduced cost.

arxiv-2311-12271.title: Approximating Maximally Localized Wannier Functions with Position Scaling-Eigenfunctions
arxiv-2311-12271.creator: Yuji Hamai, Katsunori Wakabayashi
arxiv-2311-12271.description: Abstract Position scaling-eigenfunctions are generated by transforming compactly supported orthonormal scaling functions and utilized for faster alternatives to maximally localized Wannier functions (MLWFs). The position scaling-eigenfunctions are first applied to numerical procedures solving Schrödinger and Maxwell’s equations, and the solutions well agree with preceding results.

arxiv-2401-17917.title: GuardFS : a File System for Integrated Detection and Mitigation of Linux-based Ransomware
arxiv-2401-17917.creator: Jan von der Assen, Chao Feng, Alberto Huertas Celdrán, Róbert Oleš, Gérôme Bovet, Burkhard Stiller
arxiv-2401-17917.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jan von der Assen, Chao Feng, Alberto Huertas Celdrán, Róbert Oleš, Gérôme Bovet, Burkhard Stiller. Although ransomware has received broad attention in media and research, this evolving threat vector still poses a systematic threat. Related literature has explored their detection using various approaches leveraging Machine and Deep Learning. While these approaches are effective in detecting malware, they do not answer how to use this intelligence to protect against threats, raising concerns about their applicability in a hostile environment.

arxiv-2403-09934.title: Symmetric products of Galois-Maximal varieties
arxiv-2403-09934.creator: Javier Orts
arxiv-2403-09934.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Javier Orts. The main result of this paper is the proof that all the symmetric products of a (finite) Galois-Maximal space are also Galois-Maximal spaces. This applies to the special case of real algebraic varieties, solving the problem first stated by Biswas and D’Mello in [ 6 ] about symmetric products of Maximal curves, and then generalised by Baird in [ 3 ] to Galois-Maximal curves.

arxiv-2508-11014.title: JobPulse: A Big Data Approach to Real-Time Engineering Workforce Analysis and National Industrial Policy Thanks: This system was partially supported by the Microelectronics Commons Program, a DoD initiative, under award number N00164-23-9-G056.
arxiv-2508-11014.creator: Karen S. Markel, Mihir Tale, Andrea Belz
arxiv-2508-11014.description: Abstract Employment on a societal scale contributes heavily to national and global affairs; consequently, job openings and unemployment estimates provide important information to financial markets and governments alike. However, such reports often describe only the supply (employee job seeker) side of the job market, and skill mismatches are poorly understood.

arxiv-2604-06509.creator: Jeffrey Lazar, Carlos A. Argüelles, Pavel Zhelnin

arxiv-2604-10649.creator: Rajveer Singh

pmc-10604327.title: Multi-Effects of Acute Salinity Stress on Osmoregulation, Physiological Metabolism, Antioxidant Capacity, Immunity, and Apoptosis in Macrobrachium rosenbergii
pmc-10604327.creator: Yakun Wang, Huarong Li, Jie Wei, Kunhao Hong, Qiaoyan Zhou, Xiaoli Liu, Xiaoyou Hong, Wei Li, Chao Liu, Xinping Zhu, Lingyun Yu
pmc-10604327.description: Salinity stress can trigger a series of physiological changes. However, the mechanism underlying the response to acute salinity stress in Macrobrachium rosenbergii remains poorly understood. In this study, osmoregulation, physiological metabolism, antioxidant capacity, and apoptosis were examined over 96 h of acute salinity stress. Hemolymph osmolality increased with increasing salinity.

pmc-10732581.title: Patterns of COVID-19 related lifestyle disruptions and their associations with mental health outcomes among youth and young adults
pmc-10732581.creator: Michael G. Curtis, Ysabel Beatrice Floresca, Shahin Davoudpour, Jiayi Xu, Gregory Phillips
pmc-10732581.description: The COVID-19 pandemic is a socionatural disaster that has disrupted the lives of individuals, families, and communities. Youth and young adults (YYA) were uniquely vulnerable to the proximal mental health effects of the pandemic; however, few studies have examined the long-term mental health effects of the pandemic.

pmc-11504873.title: Managing Ocular Surface Disease in Glaucoma Treatment: A Systematic Review
pmc-11504873.creator: Özlem Evren Kemer, Priya Mekala, Bhoomi Dave, Karanjit Singh Kooner
pmc-11504873.description: Ocular surface disease (OSD) is a frequent disabling challenge among patients with glaucoma who use benzalkonium chloride (BAK)-containing topical glaucoma medications for prolonged periods. In this comprehensive review, we evaluated the prevalence of OSD and its management, focusing on both current and future alternatives.

pmc-11584442.title: Comparing the hemodynamic effects of ketamine versus fentanyl bolus in patients with septic shock: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-11584442.creator: Maha Mostafa, Ahmed Hasanin, Basant Reda, Mohamed Elsayad, Marwa Zayed, Mohamed E Abdelfatah
pmc-11584442.description: BackgroundKetamine and fentanyl are commonly used for sedation and induction of anesthesia in critically ill patients. This study aimed to compare the hemodynamic effects of ketamine versus fentanyl bolus in patients with septic shock.MethodsThis randomized controlled trial included mechanically ventilated adults with septic shock receiving sedation.

pmc-11661402.title: In-Home Positioning for Remote Home Health Monitoring in Older Adults: Systematic Review
pmc-11661402.creator: Andrew Chan, Joanne Cai, Linna Qian, Brendan Coutts, Steven Phan, Geoff Gregson, Michael Lipsett, Adriana M Ríos Rincón, Anna Quialheiro, Nounagnon Frutueux Agbangla, Hans-Werner Wahl
pmc-11661402.description: BackgroundWith the growing proportion of Canadians aged >65 years, smart home and health monitoring technologies may help older adults manage chronic disease and support aging in place. Localization technologies have been used to support the management of frailty and dementia by detecting activities in the home.

pmc-12831389.title: Association between the finger-ring test and quality of life in community-dwelling older women: cross-sectional study
pmc-12831389.creator: Byung Chan Lee, Juhyun Lee, Kang Hee Cho, Changwon Moon
pmc-12831389.description: BackgroundSarcopenia is a geriatric syndrome characterized by the loss of muscle mass, strength, and physical function. Screening or early detection of sarcopenia in community settings is crucial to prevent associated adverse outcomes. The finger-ring test offers a simple self-screening method, but its clinical relevance beyond diagnostic accuracy remains underexplored.

pmc-12962706.title: “You know, we’re all human beings”: A qualitative study on the perceived needs of people experiencing chronic pain with regard to physiotherapy services
pmc-12962706.creator: Jonathan Gervais-Hupé, Arthur Filleul, Kadija Perreault, Isabelle Gaboury, Timothy H. Wideman, Céline Charbonneau, Fatiha Loukili, Anne Hudon
pmc-12962706.description: BackgroundChronic pain has many deleterious effects on the lives of those living with it. Though understanding the needs of people living with chronic pain is crucial to providing patient-centered care, current knowledge remains limited regarding the needs of this population in relation to the physiotherapy services they regularly use.

pmc-13058738.title: Prevalence of respiratory viruses in stable and acute asthma: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13058738.creator: Sachin Ananth, Gioulinta S. Alimani, Cristina Boccabella, Ekaterina Khaleva, Jan Hansel, Ran Wang, Graham Roberts, Chris Kosmidis, Apostolos Bossios, Jørgen Vestbo, Effie Papageorgiou, Nikolaos G. Papadopoulos, Apostolos Beloukas, Alexander G. Mathioudakis
pmc-13058738.description: BackgroundRespiratory viruses, frequently detected in asthma, are associated with worse outcomes. This meta-analysis systematically quantifies the prevalence of respiratory viruses in stable and acute asthma, across children and adults, and explores factors associated with increased viral burden through meta-regression.MethodsThis prospectively registered meta-analysis (PROSPERO-CRD42023375108) included studies employing molecular techniques to assess respiratory virus prevalence in asthma.

pmc-13083033.title: Is There Any Difference in Preferences Between Patients and Physicians? Evidence From Anti‐Hyperglycemic Medications Choices for Type 2 Diabetes
pmc-13083033.creator: Yuliang Xiang, Liu Liu, Jing Liu, Xiong Ke, Yanfeng Ren, Shiyi Bao, Fuming Li, Shimeng Liu, Yingyao Chen
pmc-13083033.description: AimsThis study aimed to explore differences in preferences between Chinese patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2D) and physicians when selecting anti‐hyperglycemic medications.Materials and MethodsWe conducted a discrete choice experiment (DCE) involving 1784 patients (face‐to‐face surveys) and 168 physicians (online questionnaires) across eastern, central, and western China.

pmc-13222399.title: An Exploratory Cross-Sectional Study of the Association Between Regular Cigarette Smoking and Level of Disability, Hand Dexterity, Cognitive Impairment, Fatigue, and Markers of Oxidative Stress in Male Patients With Relapsing-Remitting Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-13222399.creator: Melika Ahmadi Bonabi, Reza Mosaddeghi-Heris, Niloofar Taheri, Mahnaz Talebi, Amirreza Naseri
pmc-13222399.description: Cigarette smoking is a recognized risk factor for multiple sclerosis (MS) development and progression; however, the association between smoking and features of MS in male patients remains insufficiently explored. A cross-sectional exploratory study was conducted involving 31 male patients with approved relapsing–remitting MS (RRMS), divided into smokers (n = 9) and non-smokers (n = 22).
